about_the_game:
This DLC contains the Dimension "Arkham Mysteries". In it, you will have 5 musical themes, 5 ambient sounds and 10 stingers, all in the aesthetic of the Call of Chtullu genre. All that in the palm of your hand. The Dimension details are as follows:

D0011: Arkham Mysteries

Investigate the strange and supernatural cases rumored to occur in the isolated city of Arkham. Were they real or just urban legends to scare tourists? In any case, there is something intriguing about that city
Paid  Dimension (DLC) 

- Genre: Call of Chtullu

- Tracks:

  • Mr Detective (theme for suspense and mysterious moments)

  • The Last Breath (theme for suspense and horror moments)

  • I Can See You (theme for combat and dangerous moments)

  • Imaginary Peace (theme for resting and stillness)

  • The Fear of Midnight (theme for horror and dreadfull moments)

- Composer: Franklly Thallyson
